scanNote:
WORKBOOK 60-BET. Unit 15 'Take a Break' — lug'at va Present Perfect.

4-mashqda 4 ta surat bor. Skaner bilan tekshirildi, TO'G'RI:
  1 temple (qadimiy ustunlar va vayronalar)
  2 statue (qilich taqqan bronza haykal)
  3 paella (dengiz mahsulotlari bilan guruch taomi)
  4 flea market (rastalar va odamlar, ochiq bozor)

Qolgan mashqlar ham TO'G'RI:
  1: handmade, booked, spare, magnificent, exhibits, at least, tip, guests.
  2 (qarama-qarshi sifatlar): hot, wonderful, noisy, crowded, traditional, delicious.
  3: primitive, wasting, stand, matter, logical, erased.
  5 (10 ta noto'g'ri fe'l): buy-bought-bought, eat-ate-eaten, do-did-done, see-saw-seen, make-made-made, take-took-taken, give-gave-given, ride-rode-ridden, leave-left-left, meet-met-met.
  6: been, gone, been, gone, been.

⚠ 'BEEN' va 'GONE' FARQI — kitobda qutida tushuntirilgan:
  'has GONE to Spain' = ketgan va HALI O'ShA YERDA
  'has BEEN to Spain' = borib KELGAN, hozir bu yerda
  ⚠ 4-bandda 'They'll be back next week' bor → hali qaytmagan → GONE.
  ⚠ 1-bandda 'I went there last summer' → qaytib kelgan → BEEN.

⚠ 'PAELLA' — ispancha taom nomi, talaffuzi taxminan 'pa-EY-ya' ('ll' harflari 'y' kabi o'qiladi).
⚠ 'FLEA MARKET' = 'burga bozori' — eski, ishlatilgan narsalar sotiladigan bozor.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the words or phrases from the list below to fill in the gaps in the sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ro'yxatdagi so'z va iboralar bilan gaplardagi bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta, har biri BIR marta):
  magnificent, tip, handmade, guests,
  at least, spare, exhibits, booked


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  HANDMADE souvenirs
  2  We have BOOKED a table
  3  a SPARE key
  4  a MAGNIFICENT city
  5  the EXHIBITS in the museum
  6  AT LEAST two hours before
  7  to TIP the waiter
  8  Only the GUESTS


HAR BIRI QAYERDAN (Coursebook'dan):
  1  handmade   →  105-bet, Jekning xati
  2  booked     →  107-bet, 14-mashq
  3  spare      →  108-bet, Tipping matni
  4  magnificent → 107-bet, Madrid dialogi
  5  exhibits   →  104-105-betlar
  6  at least   →  108-bet, Tipping matni
  7  tip        →  108-bet
  8  guests     →  108-bet


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

 1  '... SOUVENIRS' — sovg'a QANDAY?
    → HANDMADE (qo'lbola)
    Xatdan: 'lovely HANDMADE souvenirs'

 2  'We have ... A TABLE at Louis'.'
    'have + V3' — Present Perfect kerak.
    Ro'yxatdagi yagona V3 shakli — BOOKED.
    'book a table' = stol band qilmoq.

 3  'give your neighbour a ... KEY'
    → SPARE (zaxira)
    Tipping matnidan: 'no one can find the
    SPARE keys'.

 4  'Paris is a ... CITY full of wonderful
     sights.'
    Shahar QANDAY? → MAGNIFICENT (ulug'vor)
    Madrid dialogidan: 'The state rooms were
    MAGNIFICENT.'

 5  'You mustn't touch the ... IN THE MUSEUM.'
    Muzeyda nimaga tegib bo'lmaydi?
    → EXHIBITS (eksponatlar)

 6  'arrive at the airport ... TWO HOURS
     before your flight'
    → AT LEAST (kamida)
    Tipping matnidan: 'tip a bellboy AT LEAST
    $5'.

 7  'Don't forget to ... THE WAITER'
    Bo'shliqdan oldin 'TO', keyin ODAM —
    demak FE'L kerak.
    Ro'yxatdagi yagona fe'l — TIP.

 8  'Only the ... can use the swimming-pool'
    Mehmonxonada basseyndan kim foydalanadi?
    → GUESTS (mehmonlar)


⚠ ENG NOZIK IKKI BAND:

  2-BAND: 'We HAVE ... a table'
     'have' dan keyin V3 kerak → BOOKED
     (ro'yxatdagi yagona '-ed' shakli).

  7-BAND: 'forget TO ... the waiter'
     'to' dan keyin ASOSIY FE'L kerak → TIP
     (ro'yxatdagi yagona fe'l).

  Ya'ni GRAMMATIKA ikkalasini hal qiladi.


DIQQAT — 'TIP' IKKI SO'Z TURKUMIDA:
  a tip (OT) = choychaqa
  to tip (FE'L) = choychaqa bermoq

  Bu mashqda FE'L sifatida (7-band).


DIQQAT — 'LOUIS'':
  'a table at LOUIS'' — restoran nomi.
  Apostrof — egalik ('Lui'ning restorani').


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  magnificent = ulug'vor
  a tip / to tip = choychaqa / bermoq
  handmade    = qo'lbola
  a guest     = mehmon
  at least    = kamida
  spare       = zaxira
  an exhibit  = eksponat
  to book     = band qilmoq
  a sight     = diqqatga sazovor joy
  a flight    = parvoz
  a waiter    = ofitsiant
  a swimming-pool = basseyn

items.sentence: 1  I bought some beautiful ................................ souvenirs at the bazaar yesterday.
items.uz: Kecha bozordan chiroyli qo'lbola sovg'alar sotib oldim.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'SOUVENIRS' — sovg'a QANDAY? → qo'lbola.

Coursebook 105-bet, Jekning xati:
'I bought some lovely HANDMADE souvenirs
there.'

hand + made — qo'shma sifat, BIRGA yoziladi.

items.sentence: 2  We have .................... a table at Louis' for tonight.
items.uz: Bugun kechqurunga Louis'da stol band qildik.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ GRAMMATIK KALIT: 'We HAVE ...' —
'have' dan keyin V3 kerak.

Ro'yxatdagi YAGONA '-ed' shakli — BOOKED.

'book a table' = stol band qilmoq
(Coursebook 107 va 108-betlar).

items.sentence: 3  It's a good idea to give your neighbour a ............ key before you go on holiday.
items.uz: Ta'tilga chiqishdan oldin qo'shningizga zaxira kalit berish yaxshi fikr.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'a ... KEY' — kalit QANDAY? → zaxira.

Coursebook 108-bet, Tipping matni:
'no one can find the SPARE keys'.

'a spare room' = mehmonxonasi.

items.sentence: 4  Paris is a .................. city full of wonderful sights.
items.uz: Parij — ajoyib diqqatga sazovor joylarga to'la ulug'vor shahar.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'a ... CITY' — shahar QANDAY? → ulug'vor.

Coursebook 107-bet, Madrid dialogi:
'The state rooms were MAGNIFICENT.'

'a sight' = diqqatga sazovor joy.

items.sentence: 5  You mustn't touch the ................ in the museum.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'IN THE MUSEUM' — muzeyda nimaga tegib
bo'lmaydi? → eksponatlar.

Coursebook 105-bet: 'to see the EXHIBITS'.

DIQQAT: 'an exhibit' = bitta buyum;
'an exhibition' = butun ko'rgazma.

items.sentence: 6  You should arrive at the airport ............................. two hours before your flight leaves.
items.uz: Parvozdan kamida ikki soat oldin aeroportga yetib borishingiz kerak.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'... TWO HOURS before' — kamida ikki soat.

Coursebook 108-bet: 'tip a bellboy AT LEAST
$5'.

'at least' = kamida;
'at most' = ko'pi bilan.

items.sentence: 7  Don't forget to ............................. the waiter when you eat at a restaurant.
items.uz: Restoranda ovqatlanganingizda ofitsiantga choychaqa berishni unutmang.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ GRAMMATIK KALIT: 'forget TO ...' —
'to' dan keyin ASOSIY FE'L kerak.

Ro'yxatdagi YAGONA fe'l — TIP.

DIQQAT: 'tip' ikki so'z turkumida:
  a tip (OT) = choychaqa
  to tip (FE'L) = choychaqa bermoq
Bu yerda FE'L.

items.sentence: 8  Only the ............................................. can use the swimming-pool at the hotel.
items.uz: Mehmonxona basseynidan faqat mehmonlar foydalana oladi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'at the HOTEL' — mehmonxonada basseyndan kim
foydalanadi? → mehmonlar.

Coursebook 108-bet: 'GUESTS who don't tip
well at hotels ...'

'a guest' = mehmon;
'a host' = mezbon.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the postcard and replace the adjectives in bold with their opposites from the list below.
exercises.instructionUz: Otkritkani o'qing va qalin harfdagi sifatlarni quyidagi ro'yxatdagi ziddi bilan almashtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (6 ta):
  noisy, wonderful, hot, traditional,
  crowded, delicious


OTKRITKANING MATNI:

  Dear Mark,
  I am writing to you from Hawaii. The weather
  is 1) COLD and I am having a 2) HORRIBLE
  time.
  The place is 3) QUIET and 4) EMPTY. Right
  now, I am eating lunch in a 5) MODERN
  restaurant. The food is 6) DISGUSTING.
  I miss you very much. See you next week.
  Love, Vicky


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  cold       →  HOT
  2  horrible   →  WONDERFUL
  3  quiet      →  NOISY
  4  empty      →  CROWDED
  5  modern     →  TRADITIONAL
  6  disgusting →  DELICIOUS


TUZATILGAN OTKRITKA:

  Dear Mark,
  I am writing to you from Hawaii. The weather
  is HOT and I am having a WONDERFUL time.
  The place is NOISY and CROWDED. Right now,
  I am eating lunch in a TRADITIONAL
  restaurant. The food is DELICIOUS.
  I miss you very much. See you next week.
  Love, Vicky


Tarjimasi:
  Hurmatli Mark,
  Senga Gavayidan yozyapman. Havo issiq va
  ajoyib vaqt o'tkazyapman.
  Joy shovqinli va gavjum. Ayni damda
  an'anaviy restoranda tushlik qilyapman.
  Ovqat juda mazali.
  Seni juda sog'indim. Kelasi hafta
  ko'rishguncha.
  Mehr bilan, Vikki


⚠ BU MAShQ — COURSEBOOK 105-BETNING
TESKARISI:

  Coursebook 105-bet, 6-mashqda AYNAN shu
  olti juftlik bor edi, lekin BOShQA
  yo'nalishda:

     CB 105-bet:  WB 60-bet:
     wonderful  →  horrible
     horrible   →  wonderful
     noisy      →  quiet
     quiet      →  noisy
     crowded    →  empty
     empty      →  crowded
     traditional → modern
     modern     →  traditional
     delicious  →  disgusting
     disgusting →  delicious
     hot        →  cold
     cold       →  hot

  Kitob ataylab teskari qilgan — juftlikni
  IKKI TOMONDAN ham bilish kerak.


OLTI ZID JUFTLIK:
  hot         ↔  cold
  wonderful   ↔  horrible
  noisy       ↔  quiet
  crowded     ↔  empty
  traditional ↔  modern
  delicious   ↔  disgusting


DIQQAT — MANTIQ:
  Tuzatilgandan keyin otkritka MANTIQIY
  bo'ladi:
     'The weather is HOT' — Gavayi issiq
     'I am having a WONDERFUL time' —
        'I miss you' bilan mos
     'The food is DELICIOUS' — restoranda
        yaxshi ovqat

  Asl matnda esa hamma narsa yomon edi,
  lekin baribir 'See you next week' deb
  yozgan — mantiqsiz.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Hawaii    = Gavayi
  to miss   = sog'inmoq
  a postcard = otkritka
  an opposite = zid so'z

pairs.whyUz:
cold ↔ HOT

'The weather is HOT' — Gavayi issiq
mamlakat, mantiqan ham to'g'ri.

Coursebook 105-bet, 6-mashqda teskarisi bor
edi: hot → cold.

pairs.left: 2  I am having a HORRIBLE time
pairs.whyUz:
horrible ↔ WONDERFUL

'to have a WONDERFUL time' — turg'un ibora
(Coursebook 105-bet, Jekning xati).

Oxiridagi 'I miss you very much' bilan ham
mos keladi.

quiet ↔ NOISY

⚠ 'QUIET' va 'QUITE' NI ADASHTIRMANG:
  QUIET /ˈkwaɪət/ = jim (SIFAT)
  QUITE /kwaɪt/   = ancha (RAVISH)

empty ↔ CROWDED

Coursebook 105-bet, Jekning xati:
'how NOISY and CROWDED it was!'

'a crowd' = olomon (OT);
'crowded' = gavjum (SIFAT).

modern ↔ TRADITIONAL

Coursebook 105-bet: 'I've been to a
TRADITIONAL restaurant.'

'a tradition' = an'ana.

disgusting ↔ DELICIOUS

Coursebook 105-bet: 'the food was just
DELICIOUS'.

'delicious' — faqat OVQAT haqida ishlatiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word(s) in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin harfdagi to'g'ri so'z(lar)ning tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  PRIMITIVE
  2  WASTING
  3  STAND
  4  MATTER
  5  LOGICAL
  6  ERASED


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'Canoes are a ... means of transport.'
    Kanoe — eng qadimiy qayiq turlaridan biri
    (yog'ochdan yasalgan, eshkak bilan).
    → PRIMITIVE (ibtidoiy, oddiy)
    'modern' bo'lsa noto'g'ri bo'lardi.

 2  'I think you're ... your time.'
    TURG'UN IBORA: 'to WASTE your time'
    = vaqtni behuda o'tkazmoq.
    'slow down your time' — bunday ibora YO'Q.
    → WASTING

 3  'I can't ... Steven. I really don't like
     him.'
    TURG'UN IBORA: 'can't STAND somebody'
    = birovni ko'rgani ko'zi yo'q.
    KALIT: 'I really DON'T LIKE him' —
    salbiy ma'no.
    'can't believe' = ishonolmayman —
    ma'noga zid.
    → STAND

 4  'What's the ... with the TV?'
    TURG'UN IBORA: 'What's the MATTER with
    ...?' = ... ga nima bo'ldi?
    'What's WRONG with ...?' ham to'g'ri,
    LEKIN 'the' bilan emas:
       'What's THE MATTER with ...?'  ✓
       'What's THE WRONG with ...?'   ✗
       'What's WRONG with ...?'       ✓
    Gapda 'THE' bor, demak MATTER.
    → MATTER

 5  'there is a ... explanation for what he
     did.'
    TURG'UN IBORA: 'a LOGICAL explanation'
    = mantiqiy izoh.
    KALIT: 'I'm SURE' — ishonch bildiryapti,
    demak oddiy izoh bor.
    → LOGICAL

 6  'The aliens ... their memories.'
    TURG'UN IBORA: 'to ERASE memories'
    = xotiralarni o'chirib tashlamoq.
    'take memories' — bunday ibora yo'q.
    → ERASED


⚠ 4-BAND — ENG NOZIK:
  Gapda 'THE' bor:
     'What's THE ... with the TV?'

  'the' faqat 'matter' bilan keladi:
     'What's THE MATTER?'  ✓
     'What's WRONG?'       ✓ ('the' siz)
     'What's THE WRONG?'   ✗

  Coursebook 101-bet, 10-mashqda ikkalasi ham
  bor edi:
     'What's THE MATTER?'
     'What's WRONG WITH YOU?'


DIQQAT — 'CAN'T STAND':
  'I can't STAND him.' = uni ko'rgani ko'zim
  yo'q
  ('stand' bu yerda 'turmoq' EMAS!)

  Shu kabi: 'I can't BEAR it.'


DIQQAT — 6-BANDDAGI 'ALIENS':
  'an alien' = o'zga sayyoralik
  Bu gap fantastik film haqida.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a canoe     = kanoe
  primitive   = ibtidoiy, oddiy
  a means of transport = transport vositasi
  to waste time = vaqtni behuda o'tkazmoq
  to slow down = sekinlashtirmoq
  can't stand = ko'rgani ko'zi yo'q
  What's the matter? = nima bo'ldi?
  logical     = mantiqiy
  an explanation = izoh, tushuntirish
  an alien    = o'zga sayyoralik
  to erase    = o'chirib tashlamoq
  a memory    = xotira

items.textEn: 1  Canoes are a primitive/modern means of transport.
items.whyUz:
Kanoe — eng qadimiy qayiq turlaridan biri
(yog'ochdan yasalgan, eshkak bilan
harakatlanadi).

→ PRIMITIVE (ibtidoiy, oddiy)

'modern' (zamonaviy) mantiqan noto'g'ri.

Coursebook 109-bet, 7-mashq: 'a canoe trip'.

items.textEn: 2  I think you're wasting/slowing down your time.
items.whyUz:
TURG'UN IBORA: 'to WASTE your time'
= vaqtni behuda o'tkazmoq.

'slow down your time' — bunday ibora YO'Q
('slow down' = sekinlashtirmoq, lekin vaqt
bilan ishlatilmaydi).

Coursebook 107-bet, Madrid dialogi:
'I see you don't WASTE YOUR TIME.'

items.textEn: 3  I can't stand/believe Steven. I really don't like him.
items.uz: Stivenni ko'rgani ko'zim yo'q. Uni umuman yoqtirmayman.
items.whyUz:
TURG'UN IBORA: 'can't STAND somebody'
= birovni ko'rgani ko'zi yo'q.

KALIT: 'I really DON'T LIKE him' — salbiy
ma'no, demak 'can't stand' mos keladi.

'can't believe' = ishonolmayman — ma'noga zid.

DIQQAT: 'stand' bu yerda 'turmoq' EMAS!

items.textEn: 4  What's the wrong/matter with the TV? I can't hear it.
items.whyUz:
⚠ ENG NOZIK BAND — GAPDA 'THE' BOR:
  'What's THE ... with the TV?'

'the' faqat 'matter' bilan keladi:
  'What's THE MATTER with ...?'  ✓
  'What's WRONG with ...?'       ✓ ('the' siz)
  'What's THE WRONG with ...?'   ✗

Coursebook 101-bet, 10-mashqda ikkalasi ham
bor edi.

items.textEn: 5  I'm sure there is a logical/strange explanation for what he did.
items.uz: Ishonchim komil, u qilgan ishning mantiqiy izohi bor.
items.whyUz:
TURG'UN BIRIKMA: 'a LOGICAL explanation'
= mantiqiy izoh.

KALIT: 'I'M SURE' — ishonch bildiryapti,
demak oddiy, tushunarli izoh bor.
'a strange explanation' — ishonchni
bildirmaydi.

'logical' — 'illogical' (mantiqsiz) ning
ziddi.

items.uz: O'zga sayyoraliklar ularning xotiralarini o'chirib tashladi.
items.whyUz:
TURG'UN BIRIKMA: 'to ERASE memories'
= xotiralarni o'chirib tashlamoq.

'take memories' — bunday ibora yo'q.

'to erase' = o'chirmoq (yozuvni, yozuvni,
xotirani).
'an alien' = o'zga sayyoralik.

exercises.instructionEn: Label the pictures with the words from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (4 ta):
  flea market, statue, temple, paella


RASMLARDA NIMA KO'RINADI:
  1  Qadimiy ustunlar va vayronalar
  2  Qo'lini cho'zgan, qilich taqqan bronza
     haykal
  3  Dengiz mahsulotlari bilan bezatilgan
     guruch taomi (yassi tovada)
  4  Rastalar va odamlar — ochiq havodagi
     bozor


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  TEMPLE       (ma'bad)
  2  STATUE       (haykal)
  3  PAELLA       (paelya)
  4  FLEA MARKET  (eski buyumlar bozori)


HAR BIRI QAYERDAN (Coursebook'dan):

  TEMPLE  →  105-bet, Jekning xati:
     'Luxor ... famous for its huge TEMPLES
      and statues'

  STATUE  →  104-bet, 2-mashq:
     'statues of lions'
     va 105-bet: 'temples and STATUES'

  PAELLA  →  107-bet, Madrid dialogi:
     'Have you tried PAELLA yet?'

  FLEA MARKET → 107-bet, Madrid dialogi:
     'the Rastro FLEA MARKET'


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  1  QADIMIY USTUNLAR → ibodat joyi → TEMPLE
     ('a temple' = ma'bad, qadimiy ibodatxona)

  2  BRONZA ODAM FIGURASI → haykal → STATUE

  3  GURUCH + DENGIZ MAHSULOTLARI →
     ispan taomi → PAELLA

  4  RASTALAR + ODAMLAR → bozor →
     FLEA MARKET


DIQQAT — 'A FLEA MARKET':
  'a flea' = burga
  'a flea market' = eski buyumlar bozori

  Nomi kulgili: eski buyumlarda burga bo'lishi
  mumkin degan hazildan kelib chiqqan.

  Coursebook 107-bet: Madriddagi 'Rastro' —
  mashhur yakshanba bozori.


DIQQAT — 'PAELLA':
  Ispaniyaning milliy taomi: guruch, za'faron,
  dengiz mahsulotlari yoki go'sht.
  Katta yassi tovada tayyorlanadi.
  O'qilishi: /paɪˈelə/ — 'paella'.


DIQQAT — 'TEMPLE' va 'CHURCH':
  a temple  = ma'bad (qadimiy dinlar)
  a church  = cherkov (xristian)
  a mosque  = masjid
  a cathedral = sobor


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a temple     = ma'bad
  a statue     = haykal
  paella       = paelya
  a flea market = eski buyumlar bozori
  to label     = nomlamoq, yorliq qo'ymoq

pairs.whyUz:
Qadimiy ustunlar — ibodat joyi → TEMPLE.

Coursebook 105-bet, Jekning xati:
'Luxor ... famous for its huge TEMPLES and
statues.'

FARQI:
  a temple = ma'bad (qadimiy dinlar)
  a church = cherkov;  a mosque = masjid

Bronza odam figurasi → STATUE.

Coursebook 104-bet, 2-mashq:
'STATUES of lions' (7-rasm).
105-bet: 'temples and STATUES'.

'the Statue of Liberty' = Ozodlik haykali
(Grammar 66-bet).

pairs.leftUz: 3-rasm: yassi tovadagi guruch va dengiz mahsulotlari
pairs.whyUz:
Guruch + dengiz mahsulotlari + katta yassi
tova → PAELLA (Ispaniyaning milliy taomi).

Coursebook 107-bet, Madrid dialogi:
'Have you tried PAELLA yet?'

O'qilishi: /paɪˈelə/.

Rastalar + odamlar → FLEA MARKET.

Coursebook 107-bet, Madrid dialogi:
'the Rastro FLEA MARKET to buy some
souvenirs'.

'a flea' = burga. Nomi hazildan kelib chiqqan:
eski buyumlarda burga bo'lishi mumkin.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the table with the past simple and the past participle of the irregular verbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni noto'g'ri fe'llarning past simple va past participle shakllari bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   INFINITIVE  PAST SIMPLE  PAST PARTICIPLE
   (V1)        (V2)         (V3)
   ──────────  ───────────  ───────────────
 1  buy         BOUGHT       BOUGHT
 2  eat         ATE          EATEN
 3  do          DID          DONE
 4  see         SAW          SEEN
 5  make        MADE         MADE
 6  take        TOOK         TAKEN
 7  give        GAVE         GIVEN
 8  ride        RODE         RIDDEN
 9  leave       LEFT         LEFT
10  meet        MET          MET


IKKI GURUHGA BO'LINADI:

  A) V2 = V3 (bir xil) — 4 ta:
       buy   → bought → BOUGHT
       make  → made   → MADE
       leave → left   → LEFT
       meet  → met    → MET

  B) V2 ≠ V3 (boshqa) — 6 ta:
       eat   → ate   → EATEN
       do    → did   → DONE

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with been or gone.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni been yoki gone bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOIDA (betdagi qutidan):

  'Mark HAS GONE to Spain.'
     (He went to Spain some time ago and he
      is STILL THERE.)

  'I HAVE BEEN to Spain.'
     (I have visited Spain and COME BACK.
      I am NOT there now.)


ENG ODDIY FARQ:
  GONE  →  ketgan va HALI U YERDA (odam YO'Q)
  BEEN  →  borib QAYTGAN (odam BOR)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  BEEN
  2  GONE
  3  BEEN
  4  GONE
  5  BEEN


HAR BIRI NEGA — KALIT GAPGA QARANG:

 1  'I have ... to the USA. I WENT THERE LAST
     SUMMER.'
    KALIT: 'I went there LAST SUMMER' — demak
    borib QAYTGAN (hozir AQShda emas).
    → BEEN

 2  'GEORGE ISN'T IN GREECE. He has ... to
     Italy.'
    KALIT: 'George ISN'T in Greece' — u
    boshqa joyda, ya'ni ITALIYADA.
    → GONE (hali u yerda)

 3  'HAVE YOU EVER ... to Bali?'
    KALIT: 'EVER' — TAJRIBA haqida savol.
    Tajriba = borib qaytish.
    → BEEN

 4  'My parents have ... to Portugal.
     THEY'LL BE BACK NEXT WEEK.'
    KALIT: 'They'll be BACK next week' —
    demak HOZIR Portugaliyada.
    → GONE

 5  'I have NEVER ... to Egypt, BUT I WANT TO
     GO one day.'
    KALIT: 'I want to GO one day' — hali
    bormagan, tajriba yo'q.
    → BEEN
    ('I have never GONE' — ishlatilmaydi)


⚠ ENG ODDIY BELGI — KEYINGI GAP:

  'I WENT there last summer.'  → BEEN (1)
  'He ISN'T in Greece.'        → GONE (2)
  'They'll be BACK next week.' → GONE (4)
  'I want to GO one day.'      → BEEN (5)

  Ya'ni har bandda YONIDAGI gap javobni
  aytib turibdi!


⚠ MUHIM QOIDA — 'I HAVE GONE' DEYARLI
IShLATILMAYDI:

  Agar o'zingiz haqingizda gapirsangiz,
  DOIM 'BEEN':
     'I have BEEN to the USA.'   ✓
     'I have GONE to the USA.'   ✗ (g'alati)

  Chunki agar AQShda bo'lsangiz, bu gapni
  ayta olmaysiz!

  'GONE' faqat BOShQA odam haqida:
     'He has GONE to Italy.'
     'My parents have GONE to Portugal.'

  Mashqda ham shunday:
     BEEN — 1, 3, 5 (I / you)
     GONE — 2, 4 (George / my parents)


BOG'LIQLIK — COURSEBOOK:
  104-bet: 'Have you ever BEEN there?'
  106-bet: 'I've BEEN to Spain.'
           'I've never BEEN to China.'
  107-bet: 'Have you BEEN to Palacio Real
            yet?'

  Coursebook'da deyarli doim 'been' —
  chunki hammasi TAJRIBA haqida.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Greece   = Gretsiya
  Italy    = Italiya
  Bali     = Bali (Indoneziya oroli)
  Portugal = Portugaliya
  to be back = qaytmoq

items.sentence: 1  I have ...................... to the USA. I went there last summer.
items.uz: AQShda bo'lganman. U yerga o'tgan yozda borgan edim.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT — KEYINGI GAP: 'I WENT there LAST
SUMMER' — demak borib QAYTGAN, hozir AQShda
emas.

→ BEEN (borib qaytgan)

Yana: o'zingiz haqingizda DOIM 'been'
('I have gone' g'alati).

items.sentence: 2  George isn't in Greece. He has ............... to Italy.
items.uz: Jorj Gretsiyada emas. U Italiyaga ketgan.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT — OLDINGI GAP: 'George ISN'T IN
GREECE' — u boshqa joyda, ya'ni HOZIR
Italiyada.

→ GONE (ketgan va hali u yerda)

DIQQAT: 'GONE' faqat BOSHQA odam haqida
ishlatiladi.

KALIT: 'EVER' — TAJRIBA haqida savol.
Tajriba = borib qaytish.

→ BEEN

Coursebook 104-bet: 'Have you ever BEEN
there?' — aynan bir xil savol.

items.uz: Ota-onam Portugaliyaga ketishgan. Kelasi hafta qaytishadi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT — KEYINGI GAP: 'They'll be BACK next
week' — demak HOZIR Portugaliyada.

→ GONE (ketgan va hali u yerda)

'to be back' = qaytmoq.

items.sentence: 5  I have never ................................... to Egypt, but I want to go one day.
items.uz: Misrda hech qachon bo'lmaganman, lekin bir kun borishni xohlayman.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT — KEYINGI GAP: 'I WANT TO GO one day'
— hali bormagan, TAJRIBA yo'q.

→ BEEN

'I have never GONE' — ishlatilmaydi.

Coursebook 106-bet: 'I've never BEEN to
China.' — aynan bir xil qolip.
